name: Island Overture
description: Ancient landmarks, tea country, wildlife and a final pause beside the sea.

days.title: Colombo arrival
days.description: Welcome and settle in after landing. If arrival time and energy allow, take an easy walk around Galle Face or Colombo Fort rather than scheduling a full sightseeing day.
days.highlights: Galle Face; local dining; recovery time

days.title: Colombo to Sigiriya
days.description: Travel inland toward the Cultural Triangle. An optional stop at the Dambulla cave-temple complex adds heritage before check-in, depending on arrival and transfer conditions.
days.highlights: Scenic drive; Dambulla optional; relaxed evening

days.title: Ancient Sigiriya
days.description: Visit Sigiriya Rock Fortress early for cooler conditions and views. Choose a gentle village experience in the afternoon, or an optional Pidurangala viewpoint if a second climb suits the group.
days.highlights: Sigiriya Rock; village life; Pidurangala optional

days.title: From Sigiriya to Kandy
days.description: Head south toward Kandy with a possible cultural or craft stop around Matale. Explore Kandy Lake and, if appropriate for the group, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.
days.highlights: Matale corridor; Kandy Lake; sacred heritage

days.title: Tea country to Ella
days.description: Cross the central highlands toward Ella, with tea scenery and a Nuwara Eliya-area stop. A rail segment is optional if schedules and seats fit; expect a longer transfer.
days.highlights: Tea estates; highland viewpoints; rail option

days.title: A slower day in Ella
days.description: Enjoy an unhurried hill-country day. Walk toward Nine Arch Bridge, take the accessible Little Adam's Peak trail if conditions suit, and allow time for cafes, tea or simply the mountain views.
days.highlights: Nine Arch Bridge; Little Adam's Peak; downtime

days.title: Ella to Yala country
days.description: Descend from the hills toward the southeastern plains. Stop for a waterfall or scenic viewpoint en route, then settle near the park and prepare for an early safari departure.
days.highlights: Changing landscapes; Ravana Falls area; rest

days.title: Safari and the south coast
days.description: Begin with a guided jeep safari in the Yala area if the park is operating. After a break, continue toward Galle; this is a substantial transfer day, so keep evening plans light.

days.title: Galle and seaside time
days.description: Walk the ramparts and lanes of Galle Fort, browse small galleries and enjoy the coastal atmosphere. Spend the afternoon at a nearby beach or leave it unscheduled.
days.highlights: Galle Fort; lighthouse area; coastal cafes

days.title: Return to Colombo
days.description: Travel back toward Colombo and the airport, with departure timing planned around road conditions and flight check-in. Add an airport-area night when flight schedules require it.

name: Kingdoms & Quiet Temples
description: A thoughtful passage through ancient cities, stone temples and living traditions.

days.title: A gentle coastal welcome
days.description: Arrive and transfer to Negombo for a low-pressure first day. Walk by the lagoon or beach if time allows, and rest before the inland journey.

days.title: Into the ancient capital
days.description: Travel north to Anuradhapura. After check-in, begin exploring selected archaeological and sacred sites at a comfortable pace, respecting dress codes and worship practices.
days.highlights: Sacred city; ancient stupas; archaeological landscape

days.title: Sacred heritage to Sigiriya
days.description: Continue the Anuradhapura visit, then head southeast toward Sigiriya. Mihintale can be an optional stop if time and mobility permit; sunset is best kept flexible.
days.highlights: Mihintale optional; rural scenery; Sigiriya area

days.title: Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa
days.description: Visit Sigiriya early, then consider an afternoon exploration of Polonnaruwa's historic monuments. This is an active heritage day; travelers preferring a slower pace can shorten the second visit.

days.title: Cave temples and Kandy
days.description: Travel south via the Dambulla Cave Temple and Matale countryside. Reach Kandy for lakeside views or an evening cultural experience depending on operating times.

days.title: Living traditions, then Colombo
days.description: Spend the morning on Kandy's cultural highlights, with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic or Peradeniya gardens as options. Continue to Colombo for the final overnight.

days.title: Departure day
days.description: Transfer to the airport with a generous travel buffer. If the flight is late, enjoy a gentle city breakfast or a short stop based on timing.

name: Tea Trails & Waterfalls
description: Cool mountain air, green tea slopes, railway scenes and cascading waterfalls.

days.title: Arrival and first impressions
days.description: Arrive and recover from travel near Colombo or Negombo. Keep the afternoon open for a short coastal or city stroll rather than a lengthy transfer.

days.title: The road to Kandy
days.description: Travel toward Kandy through changing tropical scenery. Visit Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens if time permits, then enjoy the lakeside city in the late afternoon.
days.highlights: Peradeniya option; Kandy Lake; hill gateway

days.title: Waterfalls and tea country
days.description: Follow the scenic highland road toward Nuwara Eliya, making time for a tea-estate visit or a Ramboda-area waterfall viewpoint. Evenings are cooler at this elevation.
days.highlights: Ramboda corridor; tea factory; Nuwara Eliya

days.title: The journey to Ella
days.description: Continue across tea country. Where schedules and ticketing allow, substitute part of the road transfer with a scenic train journey from the Nanu Oya area toward Ella.
days.highlights: Highland train optional; views; Ella arrival

days.title: Ella at your own pace
days.description: Photograph Nine Arch Bridge from an appropriate public viewpoint and walk Little Adam's Peak if the weather and mobility suit. Leave the afternoon open for tea, cafes or a nearby waterfall stop.
days.highlights: Nine Arch Bridge; Little Adam's Peak; Ravana area

days.title: Haputale and the green hills
days.description: Head west through Haputale's tea-growing landscape. An early Lipton's Seat outing is an option before continuing toward Belihuloya for a quieter highland evening.
days.highlights: Haputale; Lipton's Seat optional; forested hills

days.title: Back toward Colombo
days.description: Return toward Colombo or the airport by road. Allow substantial transfer time and adjust the final overnight if the flight departs early the following morning.

name: Wild Hearts of Ceylon
description: Rainforest trails, elephant country, wetlands and the wild southeast.

days.title: Arrival by the coast
days.description: Arrive and spend a low-key night near the airport. An easy beach or lagoon walk is optional, with the focus on resting before the nature circuit.

days.title: Toward the rainforest
days.description: Travel south toward a suitable Sinharaja access point and meet a local nature guide. The route and entry point should be selected with the guide and weather in mind.

days.title: A day in Sinharaja
days.description: Explore approved rainforest trails with a knowledgeable guide, looking for birds, butterflies, endemic plants and forest textures. Prioritize a respectful, low-impact visit.

days.title: Rainforest to elephant country
days.description: Drive to the dry-zone landscapes around Udawalawe. If schedules fit, consider an educational visit near the Elephant Transit Home before a quiet evening.

days.title: Udawalawe safari
days.description: Take an early or late guided jeep safari through designated park routes. Look for elephants and birdlife while respecting distance rules and natural animal behavior.

days.title: To the Yala region
days.description: Continue to the Yala gateway and settle into a safari lodge or hotel area. Keep time for local wetlands or a quiet lakeside visit rather than rushing another full activity.

days.title: Yala safari and the coast
days.description: Take a guided Yala safari, subject to park access and conditions. After a rest, travel to the Tangalle area for a gentle coastal evening; add a Bundala stop only if time and energy allow.

days.title: Return and departure
days.description: Travel from the southern coast toward Colombo or the airport. This is a significant transfer, so build the plan around flight time or add a nearby-airport night.

name: Saltwater & Slow Days
description: Fort-town charm, gentle surfing towns and room to simply enjoy the ocean.

days.title: Arrive on the south coast
days.description: Transfer from the airport toward Galle or Unawatuna and check in. Keep the remainder of the day free for rest and a first seaside dinner. A late flight may require an airport-area first night.

days.title: Explore Galle Fort
days.description: Take a leisurely walk through Galle Fort's streets, ramparts and galleries. Enjoy the lighthouse area and sea views, leaving time for cafes or boutiques.

days.title: A true beach day
days.description: Enjoy a largely unscheduled day by the ocean. Choose a calm shoreline, a scenic cafe or a short coastal excursion according to water conditions and personal preference.

days.title: Weligama and the surf coast
days.description: Travel east along the coast to Weligama. Beginners may arrange a lesson with a qualified surf instructor when conditions are suitable; non-surfers can simply enjoy the bay.
days.highlights: Weligama Bay; coastal villages; surf option

days.title: The Mirissa mood
days.description: Continue to Mirissa for a quiet day by the shoreline. A responsible, licensed whale-watching trip is a seasonal optional activity, not a guaranteed inclusion.
days.highlights: Mirissa beach; coastal cafes; seasonal sea option

days.title: Tangalle and slower shores
days.description: Travel to the Tangalle area and choose a quieter beach setting. Spend the afternoon relaxing, reading, enjoying local seafood or taking an appropriate guided nature excursion.

days.title: Coast to airport
days.description: Return toward Colombo and the airport with ample time for traffic and check-in. For early departures, the final night should be shifted closer to the airport.
